messages:
Lena CSM: FYI — MeridianHealth onboarding metrics show intermittent p95 spikes on the /summarize endpoint during morning batch processing. Renewal meeting in 9 days; want to proactively recommend a low-risk perf experiment: route short summaries to a compact int8 variant, enable prefix KV caching for session continuity, and throttle batch_delay to smooth tails. Thoughts?

Diego Eng: Agreed. We have redwood/sum-compact-int8 ready. For batching, lowering max_batch_delay from 50ms -> 20ms helped another customer. I'll prepare a routing patch and a small dedicated canary.

Ava ML: Quality check: create a 120-sample golden set from anonymized customer data to compare ROUGE-L proxy and hallucination heuristics. Also check for systematic token truncation when quantizing; add a char-length sanity check.

Theo Platform: Proposed rollout: staging smoke -> 3% production canary for 90 minutes -> 15% for 6 hours -> full. Canary gates: p95 not worse than baseline + 20ms, errors <= +0.5% absolute, quality delta <= 2% relative. I'll reserve a 2-GPU slice on the dedicated pool and disable burst for the test window.

Lena CSM: Can we have a two-line customer note I can share before their renewal call? Keep it simple: non-disruptive trial, rollback plan, expected improvements.

Diego Eng: Two-line note: "We're running a brief performance trial that routes short summaries to a compact quantized model to reduce latency and cost. We'll closely monitor quality and have a rollback plan ready; expected ~25% p95 improvement on short requests."

OpsBot: Canary scheduled: MeridianHealth /summarize at 2026-09-03T09:00Z (3% traffic, 90m). Monitoring: perf-alerts + eval-harness.

Ava ML: I'll run the eval harness at canary start and post a summary. Fail criteria: ROUGE-L drop >2% or hallucination rate up >1.5x. Also will sample 20 outputs for manual review.

Diego Eng: Routing snippet (for console):

```json
{ "routes": [{"name":"short-sum","match":"input_tokens <= 100","model":"redwood/sum-compact-int8"},{"name":"long-sum","match":"input_tokens > 100","model":"redwood/sum-std"}], "canary":{"percent":3,"duration_minutes":90} }
```

Diego Eng: CLI: rwctl routes apply -f meridian-route.json --canary 3  ||  rwctl routes rollback meridian-route --to previous

Theo Platform: Dashboard link will be posted at canary start. Owners: Diego (deploy/rollback), Ava (quality), Lena (customer comms). OpsBot: please ping #renewals if a gate trips.

Lena CSM: Thanks team — please drop the customer note here and tag me when the canary is green so I can brief the account owner before the renewal meeting.

Diego Eng: Dropped note above.

Ava ML: I'll post eval results within 30 minutes of canary end.

-- thread end --
